title: Count vowels
prompt: Specification: count_vowels(s) returns the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in s, case-insensitively. Select the implementation that satisfies the specification.

candidates.code:
def count_vowels(s):
    return sum(1 for ch in s if ch in "aeiou")

def count_vowels(s):
    return sum(1 for ch in s.lower() if ch in "aeiou")

def count_vowels(s):
    return sum(1 for ch in s if ch in "aeioAEIO")

def count_vowels(s):
    return sum(1 for ch in s if ch in "aeiouy")

evidence.body: Each candidate was executed on three inputs. Expected counts follow the specification.

recommendation.text: Implementation B is correct. It lowercases the string before testing membership in "aeiou", so uppercase vowels are counted too.
